column1: # Wan-Dancer model manifest for ComfyUI (native workflow).
#                speed    = LightX2V lightning LoRA (fast, fewer steps)
#   filename     path inside the repo. Only the basename has to be correct:
#                scripts/download.py resolves the real in-repo path through the
#                HuggingFace API when the given path does not exist, so a
#                "split_files/" prefix moving around upstream will not break it.
# Sizes are approximate; the two dancer experts dominate (~16 GB each).
# --- Wan-Dancer 14B experts: global choreography + local motion refinement ---
# Override with WD_TEXT_ENCODER=fp16 to pull umt5_xxl_fp16.safetensors instead.
# --- Vision encoder: preserves identity/clothing from the reference image ----
# --- Wan 2.1 VAE: latent encode/decode for video frames ----------------------
# --- Audio encoder: turns the music track into conditioning embeddings -------
# --- LightX2V lightning LoRA: far fewer sampling steps per clip --------------
# --- Optional: full-precision text encoder (only with WD_DOWNLOAD_OPTIONAL=1)-
